chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Muhammad ibn Ubaydullah, who said:

Abu Al-Hasan Al-Reza (peace be upon him) said: 'A man maintains goodly relations with his relatives, and it so happens that there remains three years from his life, and Allah makes it to become thirty years, and Allah does whatever He so Desires to.'
ai.seo_question: How does maintaining family ties affect a person's lifespan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam Al-Rea (peace be upon him) illustrates the metaphysical potency of silat al-rahim (maintaining kinship ties), noting that Allah may multiply a person's remaining lifespan from three to thirty years as a direct reward. This narration underscores the Shia belief that familial piety is not merely a social duty but a spiritual mechanism that alters one's destiny and physical existence through divine decree.
